scope: Local common Claude generation and reviewed source-card preparation. No paid generation or deployment.

providerBasis.finding: Claude does not support maxItems; minItems supports only 0 and 1. Closed objects, null, anyOf and local references are supported. Simply restoring maxItems is not a compatible fix.

wireContract.drivers: Closed object of at most three slots, first required non-null; no fourth key allowed.
wireContract.watch: Closed object with zero to two optional slots, bounded by the full local schema.
wireContract.implications: Empty object in the managed Claude wire contract; decoded to the existing empty array.
wireContract.decode: Only contiguous filled slots are converted in order. Extra, missing or gapped slots are rejected. Never trim, invent, repair or rewrite prose.
wireContract.ledgerTargets: Finite enum of existing normalized title/text locations. Full ledger coverage and source-reference validation still run locally.
wireContract.otherConstraints: Unsupported length/pattern/reference-array limits remain in the unchanged full local validator and an explicit plan audit list. They are not falsely claimed as provider-enforced.
wireContract.budgetAndTransport: No limit increase, retries or automatic model fallback. Wire checks follow budget/duplicate guards and precede provider connection.

cardPolicy.sameSpeakerCondition: Match the already-reviewed eventKey, independenceKey and attribution. Inline the qualification with its related explanation; do not infer expert disagreement.
cardPolicy.reviewRequiredSignal: A same-speaker condition labelled with the known priority-dispute expression is held for card review, not declared false or silently rewritten. This narrow signal is not a universal semantic classifier.
cardPolicy.conflicts: Explicit contradicts evidence still requires adjudication and is never hidden by condition grouping.
cardPolicy.sampleRevision: A separate input-card copy removes the unsupported priority-disagreement characterization. Existing source, manuscript and cost records remain unchanged.

inputFactoring.method: Exactly identical allowed-use and scope-rule values are sent once with references. Distinct rules are not merged; reconstruction is tested for equality.

verification.storedFourDriverOutput: Still rejected; no repair or retroactive approval.
verification.normalStoredManuscript: Synthetic slot-format replay reconstructs the exact same content. A replay-only ledger version refresh does not reuse old approvals.
verification.remaining: No real provider request or new generated-quality evaluation in this change.
